title: Kumaran Rajini Rasigan
desc: Bujji moves to Chennai after an argument with his childhood friend Chitti. He returns after 12 years to prove his love for her.

title: Amman Kovil Vasalile
desc: Ponrasu, an honest man, is at loggerheads with Sethupathi, an evil man. Impressed by his good nature, Pongothai falls for Ponrasu, but things take an ugly turn when Sethupathi wants to marry her.

title: Thirupathi Ezhumalai Venkatesa
desc: Three friends, Thirupathi, Ezhumalai and Venkatesa, marry the three daughters of a watchman, Nachiappan, after renting an apartment in the same bungalow where Nachiappan works.

title: Pagal Nilavu
desc: Selvam is indebted to Devarajan, a big shot in town, for saving his mother. When he falls in love with the sister of the new police inspector, Devarajan plans to make good use of the situation.

title: Mappillai
desc: Rajarajeswari gets Arumugam's sister arrested after she learns that she is in love with her son. Arumugam decides to marry her daughter Geetha in order to teach her a lesson.
